notes.title: Get into the festive mood with the Dream Ski Slope Battle Pass!
notes.content:
[h3]🎿 Build Your Dream Ski Slope with Our Festive Battle Pass! 🎄[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41543593/316d0584d786a986f79c9e49ff70b0324b9d16d7.png[/img]

From December 13 to December 26, bring the holiday spirit to your Global City! Construct a stunning ski resort, welcome skiers to your slopes, and enjoy the thrill of winter competitions.

🌟 Features include:
[list]
[*] Ski Slope & Resort Construction to expand your city.
[*] Collect seasonal rubies to unlock exclusive rewards.
[*] Participate in exciting competitions and showcase your city-building talent.
[/list]

Get ready to celebrate the holidays in style—start building your winter paradise today! ❄️⛷️

notes.title: Create a high-tech city with the new Battle Pass!
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome to Science Valley! 🌟 [/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dqcf3lp.png[/img]

Embark on an exciting journey with the new project “Silicon Valley I” in your city tablet! Here's what awaits you:

[h3]🏭 [i]New Factory & Resource[/i][/h3]
Unlock the Semiconductor Factory, craft Microchips, and power up your city's growth.
Use Microchips in core gameplay tasks like orders or trade them on the Exchange!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ViJVTok.png[/img]

[h3]🎯[i] Project Stages[/i][/h3]
The first stage of Silicon Valley launches now, with more to come in future updates.
Get ready to bring cutting-edge innovation to your city! 🏙️✨

What part of Science Valley excites you the most? Let’s discuss below! 👇
